subject: Discovery recap + procurement path alignment for ACME
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Liz Chen <liz.chen@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-10T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Discovery recap + procurement path alignment for ACME

Hi Liz —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap (so we’re all aligned) and proposed next steps: 

What we heard
- ACME is evaluating low-latency, multi-tenant inference for product search reranking and conversational assistance across US regions.
- Primary success metrics: median p99 token latency under 150ms and predictable monthly unit cost.
- Security/compliance: need SOC2 evidence, VPC options for sensitive workflows, and vendor onboarding paperwork.

Open procurement questions
- Preferred payment path: Purchase Order (PO) vs corporate card vs cloud marketplace (AWS Marketplace). You mentioned procurement typically prefers PO. Can you confirm?
- Vendor paperwork required: W-9, vendor form, any additional compliance attestation.

Proposed next steps
1) I’ll share a concise pricing sheet and a draft SOW (attached) tailored to the usage profile you shared.
2) If PO is preferred, please loop procurement and confirm billing address + W-9 tax info. If marketplace is preferred, we’ll share the listing and estimated lead time.
3) Can we tentatively set a follow-up to review procurement requirements Thurs 2027-01-17 at 10:00 AM PT?

Attachments: pricing-sheet-v2.xlsx (xlsx), redwood-sow-draft.docx (docx)

Please let me know if I missed anything. If procurement wants to handle vendor forms directly, I’m happy to include them on the call.

Best,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Sean — quick internal note before you send vendor docs out to procurement: 
- Attach a clean PO-friendly quote (line items, SKU descriptions, term, payment term net 30). I drafted quote_PO_clean.pdf (attached).
- Include W-9 and vendor onboarding packet. Procurement often asks for our bank ACH info; confirm with finance if ACH is acceptable — otherwise clarify card vs PO billing.
- Also flag AWS Marketplace option in your email as an alternative; some customers close faster via marketplace if they already use it.

I’ve added Marissa for any SSO/SCIM questions — she can own technical onboarding during the trial.

Thanks — KP

Subject: Vendor packet + PO quote (per request)

Hi Liz / Procurement —

Following up with the vendor packet and the PO-ready quote attached. Highlights: 
- Quote covers a 12-month committed bundle aligned to the usage profile discussed; line items for Hosted API + Dedicated throughput add-on + Redwood Optimize.
- Payment options: PO (net 30) or corporate card. If you prefer AWS Marketplace, we can provide pricing and turn-up timeline (typically 2–3 weeks to finish listing + procurement approvals).

Attachments:
- quote_PO_clean.pdf (PDF)
- vendor-onboarding-W9.pdf (PDF) — includes our legal name and EIN.
- pricing-sheet-v2.xlsx (as previously shared)

DocuSign onboarding link (if helpful): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/redwood-acme-onboarding
HubSpot proposal record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/98765

Requested info from procurement to move forward with a PO:
1) Billing address exactly as it should appear on the PO
2) Primary billing contact + email
3) Any special vendor terms or PO reference language required

I’m happy to jump on the Jan 17 slot to walk through anything — please confirm.

Best,
Sean
From: Procurement Team <procurement@acmeretail.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Liz Chen <liz.chen@acmeretail.com>, Mark Turner <mark.turner@acmesolutions.com>
Date: 2027-01-12T08:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor packet + PO quote (per request)

Sean —

Thanks for the materials. A few items procurement needs clarified before issuing a PO: 
- Billing address: Please confirm the vendor billing address exactly as it should appear on the PO and if there are alternate remit addresses for ACH.
- Tax ID: The W-9 included shows an EIN; confirm the tax name matches the legal entity we should list.
- Payment terms: We typically request net 45 for new vendors; will Redwood accept net 45 or negotiate net 30?
- Security: We require SOC2 report and the contact for security attestations (for our vendor risk team).
- SSO/SCIM: For enterprise SSO integrations, who should our technical team contact to scope SCIM+SSO?

Please respond with the above; once confirmed we’ll circulate a PO draft.

Procurement Team
ACME Retail
procurement@acmeretail.com

Subject: Quick check: procurement status ahead of tomorrow’s sync

Hi Liz / Procurement —

Quick nudge ahead of our 1/17 sync: any update on the items procurement asked for? To recap we need: 
- Confirm billing address + remit instructions
- Confirm payment terms (net 30 vs net 45)
- Confirmation that vendor-onboarding-W9.pdf tax name matches your vendor record

If the PO path is still preferred but procurement needs more time, we can also proceed on a 30-day pilot via card while PO is finalized — whichever accelerates your evaluation.

Let me know the fastest path and I’ll be on the call tomorrow to help unblock.

Thanks,
Sean
